economic_hypothesis: A broad bear state contains both slow inventory erosion and fast forced liquidation. A stock that has fallen at least eight percent over the ten completed sessions before the signal, then prints the frozen OAI active-demand ignition while all-market twenty-session breadth is recovering, is more consistent with a capitulation transfer than with a weak bounce in a grinding decline.

scientific_governance.required_next_test: one newly arriving, never-used future period

causal_market_state.bear: market median ret20 <= 0 AND market median ret60 <= 0 AND positive-ret20 share <= 0.50 AND positive-ret60 share <= 0.50
causal_market_state.breadth_repair: positive-ret20 share at the completed signal close is strictly greater than its value five completed market sessions earlier
causal_market_state.entry_clock: first legal executable open strictly after the completed signal

base_conditions: completed close above the maximum high of the prior five completed sessions
stock_signal.fast_capitulation_gate: prior10_return <= -8%, where prior10_return ends at the completed session immediately before the signal

execution.entry: first legal executable open after the signal, no later than three market sessions
execution.time_stop: after 60 completed holding sessions, exit at next legal executable open

capacity.daily_cap_selection: smallest of the predeclared 5, 10 and 20 caps retaining more than fifty capacity-accepted completed trades per year on average
capacity.same_date_rank: higher signal close location, then higher signal turnover ratio, then event_id

primary_portfolio.cohort_sizing_diagnostic: 10% sleeve-NAV date budget with a 2.5% per-name cap was weaker and is not selected
